key_facts: Initial visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/30 OS
Vision deteriorated to 20/30 OD and counting fingers OS over time
Slit lamp examination revealed subconjunctival fibrosis
Slit lamp examination revealed symblepharon formation
Slit lamp examination revealed corneal neovascularizations
Slit lamp examination revealed conjunctival hyperemia
Conjunctival biopsy and immunofluorescent histology revealed an unspecific result
Reduction in conjunctival hyperemia and corneal vascularizations after therapy

raw.rationale: The presence of subconjunctival fibrosis, symblepharon formation, corneal neovascularizations, and conjunctival hyperemia are characteristic findings in Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid, which is a chronic autoimmune disease that affects the conjunctiva and cornea.

rejected.label: Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid
rejected.why: While Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid can also affect the eyes, it typically involves the oral mucosa and other mucous membranes, and the presentation is not as specific to the eye as in this case.

rejected.label: Chronic Ocular Graft-Versus-Host Disease
rejected.why: There is no mention of a history of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation or other risk factors for Graft-Versus-Host Disease, making this diagnosis less likely.
